answer: The admission bond is time locked for 10 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in wharf, expire in timber, and crystal lists each expiry. Someone running 176 aliases hence needs 116 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3498 identities would post 1523 proofs and burn roughly 5 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
